page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is built on a KVM hypervisor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The server is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.1 GHz. The CPU hardware configuration consists of 12 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, providing 24 dedicated vCPUs. Memory capacity totals 96 GB, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Processor cache allocations include 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 35 MB L3 cache. Advanced CPU flags include support for AVX, AVX-512, AES cryptography, and BMI2. The instance contains no integrated GPU accelerators and offers no onboard local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent data operations. Baseline network throughput is configured at 8 Gbps.

Standard benchmark measurements place the processing capabilities of the instance within average ranges across synthetic and application-level tests. Single-core stress-ng CPU execution measured 1438.39, while multi-core stress-ng reached 23015.19. Synthetic multi-core benchmarks returned a Geekbench score of 9875.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 23637.6. Memory throughput tests demonstrated 109.43 GB/sec for large uncached reads and 48.03 GB/sec for uncached writes. Under key-value store workloads, the system sustained a Redis SET rate of 22.14 million operations per second. Static web serving throughput reached 17.13 GB/sec. Large language model inference benchmarks using a 135M parameter model yielded 1294.61 tokens per second during prompt processing and 78.25 tokens per second during text generation.

The balance of 24 vCPUs and 96 GB RAM provides resource density suitable for compute workloads requiring standard memory allocations per thread. Cost efficiency is determined by resource utilization, as the instance offers dedicated CPU resources without bundled storage fees. Operational trade-offs include the necessity to attach external cloud storage for operating system and application data, which affects total storage I/O performance depending on the selected volume type. The absence of GPU acceleration restricts execution of massive neural networks, though small-scale inference remains feasible on the CPU. The hardware configuration aligns with enterprise web hosting, software compilation pipelines, middle-tier application servers, and relational database management systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with 12 physical cores and 24 dedicated vCPUs. It features 96 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, alongside 8 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. The instance includes hardware instruction set extensions such as AVX-512 and AES, but lacks integrated local storage and GPU accelerators. In benchmark testing, the instance achieved a multi-core PassMark CPU score of 23637.6, a Geekbench multi-core score of 9875.0, and a Redis SET performance of 22.14 million operations per second. Memory bandwidth reached 109.43 GB/sec for large uncached reads. For machine learning tasks, prompt processing reached 1294.61 tokens/sec on a 135M parameter LLM. The lack of onboard SSD storage necessitates reliance on network-attached volumes, making this instance balanced for general enterprise application hosting, web serving, software compilation, and database processing.
